name: ticket-summarizer
description: Fetches Azure DevOps or Jira work items, either an explicit list of tickets or everything matching a date range and status (active, or delivered/closed between two dates, always scoped to Story/Bug/Epic types, plus Feature on Azure DevOps), and summarizes each into a plain-language, client-facing blurb suited for a status update deck: concise, targeting one to two sentences and extending to three or four only as a last resort. Prints one ready-to-paste brief line per item (id, title, blurb, assignee); a date range can be typed as --from/--till or shortened to a --range this-week/last-week/this-month/last-month preset, and --status accepts a comma-separated combination of active/delivered/closed/updated. States what was delivered and, only when the ticket itself supports it, why it matters; never invents a business-value claim. Read-only against the tracker: no tracker writes, no tracker diff-and-confirm gate. Optionally sends the summary to Slack/Teams, saves it to a file, or copies it straight to the clipboard, but only after asking. Auto-installs issuekit; bring your own MCPs.
